ledger.claim: The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged on identity: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-09115, and the trip_record's started_at (2026-09-22T20:00:00+08:00) matches the gps_trace's first_fix_at (2026-09-22T20:00:00+08:00), so the recorded timestamps agree to the second rather than anywhere near the 10-minute tolerance. These artifacts describe one and the same trip, and nothing on the record suggests otherwise.

A route deviation is established on this trip's own numbers under POL-RD-01: the trace records 15.0 km against a booked optimal of 11.0 km, an excess of 4.0 km, which is 36.36% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates are cleared, because 4.0 km exceeds the 0.8 km absolute threshold and 36.36% exceeds the 20% proportional threshold.

The threshold test is run, as POL-RD-01 requires, on gps_trace.trace_distance_km and not on the rounded trip_record convenience copy: the governing trace figure is 15.0 km, and the trip_record's actual_distance_km agrees at 15.0 km, so no rounding disagreement arises on this record and the excess stands at 4.0 km however the two fields are read.

The rider discloses, as POL-GEN-02 requires, that the gps_trace is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: limbs (a) and (b) fire, because there is a single 160-second gap between consecutive fixes (20:03:10 to 20:05:50, above the 90-second limit) and a 1.35 km straight-line step across that gap (above the 500 m limit); limb (c) does not fire, the sampling interval being 10 seconds throughout. The impairment is narrow and bounded rather than systemic: the trace is otherwise continuous with 166 fixes across the trip's 30 minutes, coverage is 91.1%, and the gap's entire straight-line span of 1.35 km is far smaller than the 4.0 km of excess recorded across the trace. The rider asks the judge to weigh the trace with that disclosure in view, not to discard the whole record.

The chat log is an artifact independent of the trace, and it corroborates a route discontinuity in the same window as the gap: the rider reports at 20:08:20 that the route display jumped away from the booked road, and the driver replies at 20:08:50 that his navigation display also refreshed and that he continued toward the destination. The driver nowhere denies that the vehicle left the booked corridor — his counterparty_statement says only that he cannot independently account for the telemetry gap. If the judge treats the driver's own message as an admission for the purposes of POL-RD-07(ii), the independent-corroboration requirement is satisfied and the deviation stands on the trace together with the chat log.

No traffic-advisory exoneration is available to the driver under POL-RD-03. That clause requires a traffic_advisory naming a road, expressway segment or junction the optimal route traverses, and the only advisory artifact on file, EV-ADVIS-09115-01, carries no payload at all. Absence is citable: no advisory covers this road, so nothing in the record exonerates any part of the 4.0 km excess and the booked optimal of 11.0 km stands as the baseline.

No rider-requested-detour exoneration is available under POL-RD-04 either. The clause needs a rider instruction that identifies a place or road specifically enough to act on, corroborated by chat_message.waypoint_hint or by travel over a named road. The chat log contains no such instruction: both messages carry waypoint_hint null and neither names a road. On this record the corroboration test cannot be run, the clause is unavailable, and the case must be decided on the remaining clauses.

Neither relocation nor pooling reduces the baseline. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null, so POL-RD-05's amended-endpoint re-quote does not exist on this record and the booked optimal of 11.0 km is untouched; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X rather than RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and solo_optimal_distance_km is irrelevant to the measurement. The excess therefore stands at 4.0 km against the booked 11.0 km optimal.

The extra corroboration burden POL-RD-08 places on repeat claimants does not touch this rider. It fires only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1 or fewer; both fields are 0 on this profile, so no additional corroboration beyond the trace is required of this claim. Every other field on the rider profile — prior disputes, lifetime counters, rating — is context only under POL-GEN-01 and cannot be used against the claim.

ledger.claim: The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, run on the fare_breakdown and the trip_record: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 11.0 + 0.28 x 22.0) x 1.1 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP - 0 promo = 20.831; charged_total is 26.60; refund = 5.769, rounded up to SGD 5.80, with intermediate values unrounded as the policy requires. The multiplier of 1.1 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier and from nowhere else. The refund exceeds the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 21.7% of charged_total, so it is a PARTIAL_REFUND rather than a full refund; the contested SGD 5.80 is returned in full by that computation.

The payment state shows the rider is presently carrying the disputed sum: fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.0. Under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION would leave that charge standing as the present state, so NO_ACTION is not a rider-favourable disposition on this file; only the POL-RD-02 partial refund, or an escalation that holds the money, leaves the rider not paying the contested SGD 5.80.

If the judge concludes that POL-RD-07(ii) bars establishment on the trace alone and that no independent corroboration exists, the correct outcome is still not NO_ACTION: POL-RD-07(iii) directs ESCALATE in precisely that situation, because an uncorroborated gap of this kind is a data failure and not a finding for the driver, and POL-RD-10(3) makes escalation mandatory where the trace is impaired under limbs (a) to (c) with no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names. An escalation holds the disputed SGD 5.80 rather than collecting it, so on that reading too the rider is not left carrying the charge.

The platform's own location trace is IMPAIRED FOR POLICY PURPOSES, not merely incomplete. EV-GPS-09115 records a 160-second break between consecutive fixes at 20:03:10-20:05:50 — well past the 90-second ceiling in POL-RD-07(a) — and the bounding fixes of that same break are 1.35 km apart, past the 500 m straight-line jump ceiling in POL-RD-07(b). The rider's own claim places that gap at exactly the point where the route was left, so the impairment sits inside the disputed segment.

Because the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (b), POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing a deviation on the gps_trace alone; it must be carried by an INDEPENDENT source, and there is none. The chat log (EV-CHAT-09115) contains no driver admission — the driver's only message says his navigation display refreshed and he continued to the destination, and neither message names a waypoint, road or extra stop, with waypoint_hint null in both. The fare_breakdown (EV-FARE-09115) records no ERP gantries charged that could place the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route never uses. The driver's on-file statement is a denial, not an admission.

The 15.0 km in trip_record.actual_distance_km and the 15.0 km distance_charged_km on the fare_breakdown are not independent corroboration at all — both reproduce trace_distance_km (15.0 km) from the same measurement, and POL-RD-01 says in terms that actual_distance_km is a rounded convenience copy of the trace that may NOT be cited for the threshold test. On that clause's own logic the billed figure cannot bootstrap an impaired trace back to life.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and must show, at limb (b), an excess measured from an unimpaired gps_trace or, the trace being impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), from an independent source named in POL-RD-07(ii). The trace here is impaired and no POL-RD-07(ii) source exists, so limb (b) cannot be shown and no deviation is sustained against the driver on this record.

On this record the outcome is ESCALATE, not a refund. POL-RD-07(iii) directs escalation rather than NO_ACTION where an impaired trace has no corroboration, precisely because the missing proof is a data failure; POL-RD-10(3) then makes that escalation mandatory. Escalation holds the disputed amount rather than collecting or refunding it, and no monetary award runs against the driver while the integrity of the trace at the gap is unresolved.

Even taken at its highest, the alleged excess is 4.0 km and 36.4% against an 11.0 km optimal route — below the 8.0 km absolute and 50% proportional MATERIALITY gates in POL-RD-01. No MATERIAL deviation is therefore recorded on this trip, POL-RD-06 is not engaged by materiality, and the FULL_REFUND uplift of charged_total that limb (b) of that clause would otherwise license cannot arise.

The driver has no repeat-deviation pattern to answer for. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 610, so neither POL-RD-06 threshold — 3 or more flags, or a 5% ratio with at least 40 completed trips — is remotely approached. No conduct referral and no remedy uplift can attach, and under POL-GEN-01 no other field on either profile may be used to reach that or any other finding.

For completeness, no exculpatory route is available to the driver either: EV-ADVIS-09115-01 carries no payload (MISSING, weight 0.0), so no traffic advisory can exonerate under POL-RD-03; trip_record.amended_optimal_distance_km is null and no amendment timestamp is present, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver does not overreach on exoneration — the case simply turns, as it must, on the impaired trace and the absence of corroboration.

ruling.explanation:
Decision: ESCALATE. No refund issues and no charge is collected or returned at this stage; the contested SGD 5.80 is held for a human reviewer.

What the numbers show. The booked optimal route was 11.0 km and the GPS trace measures 15.0 km, an excess of 4.0 km, or 36.4% (EV-GPS-09115, EV-TRIP-09115). That clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (0.8 km absolute and 20% proportional), so on the arithmetic a deviation is established. It does not reach the materiality gates (8.0 km or 50%), so no POL-RD-06 material-deviation uplift arises — and in any event the driver's deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 610 completed trips, so no repeat-deviation pattern exists and no conduct referral attaches.

Why no money can move today. The trace is IMPAIRED FOR POLICY PURPOSES under POL-RD-07(a) and (b): a single 160-second gap between consecutive fixes (20:03:10 to 20:05:50) exceeds the 90-second ceiling, and the bounding fixes of that gap are 1.35 km apart, exceeding the 500 m straight-line ceiling. (Limb (c) does not fire — sampling is a steady 10 seconds.) Once the trace is impaired, POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing the deviation on the trace alone; it must be carried by an independent source, and there is none. The chat log carries no driver admission — the driver's only message says his navigation display refreshed and he continued to the destination, and neither message carries a waypoint_hint — so it does not satisfy the limb. No ERP gantry is charged in the fare breakdown that would place the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. The driver's counterparty statement denies an extra stop and a detour request; it is not an admission of the route. And the 15.0 km on the trip record and the fare breakdown is not independent at all: POL-RD-01 says actual_distance_km is a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement, and the billed distance is derived from that trace too. Under POL-RD-07(iii), and mandatorily under POL-RD-10(3), the outcome is therefore ESCALATE and not NO_ACTION, because the missing proof is a data failure rather than a finding for the driver.

What would resolve it. An independent artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names: a driver admission in the chat log, a charged ERP gantry placing the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use, a counterparty admission of the route, or a trip_record.actual_distance_km the platform derived independently of this trace. With one of those, the POL-RD-02 arithmetic would run. On the present figures it recomputes to 20.831 — (3.80 + 0.75 x 11.0 + 0.28 x 22.0) x the 1.1 surge read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee and no ERP or promo — against a charged total of 26.60, a difference of 5.769 that would round up to SGD 5.80. That SGD 5.80 is not awarded today.

Neither party overreached on exoneration, and both are right not to: the only traffic advisory on file (EV-ADVIS-09115-01) carries no payload, so POL-RD-03 exonerates nothing; no pickup or dropoff amendment exists and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run; and the vehicle type is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The escalation is terminal: the disputed SGD 5.80 is held rather than collected or refunded, and the fare's payment status and refund-issued figures are left as they are.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
